title: Assistant runs on hard-coded 'openai / gpt-4o-mini' until settings load: pill/footer show it, and sending then creates the chat on that provider
repro: Stack A (configured default provider = OpenRouter / nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free)
In-page latency shim: delay every /api fetch (window.fetch wrapper, 2.5–8 s) to simulate a slow backend
Navigate Home → Assistant (in-memory, no reload)
Observe the header model pill and the sidebar footer during load
Before the chat list/settings arrive, type in the composer and press Enter (the shim blocks every non-GET, so nothing reached the backend)
expected: Until settings/providers are loaded, the model pill shows a neutral loading state and the composer and 'New' are disabled (or submit waits). A new chat always uses the configured default provider and model.
actual: The pill reads 'gpt-4o-mini STRICT' and the footer reads 'gpt-4o-mini · Cloud' with a green 'healthy' dot. These are the useState defaults, not the user's configuration. The composer and 'New' stay enabled. Pressing Enter issued POST /api/modules/assistant/chats with body {"providerConfigId":"openai","model":"gpt-4o-mini","promptPresetId":"strict-grounded"}, so the chat would be persisted on an unconfigured/disabled provider (or a paid OpenAI model if a key exists). Every Assistant mount also fires a needless GET /providers/openai/models before settings arrive.

codeRefs.note: useState('openai') / useState('gpt-4o-mini') placeholder defaults render as real config
createChat posts providerId||settings.defaultProviderId — providerId is the 'openai' placeholder while settings are null
models effect fires for the placeholder provider id
footer falls back to 'Cloud' label + green dot with no provider loaded

suggestedFix: Initialise providerId/model to null and track a configLoaded flag. Render the pill/footer as a skeleton until refreshConfig resolves, and disable the composer submit and 'New' until then (or queue the submit). Skip the /providers/{id}/models effect while providerId is null. In createChat, prefer settings.defaultProviderId over the placeholder.

title: Loading states show confident empty/zero content: '0 local', 'designs 0', 'No chats yet.', 'New chat', 'No tasks yet.', 'No pages yet' flash
repro: In-page latency shim: delay every /api fetch 2.5 s (window.fetch wrapper)
Navigate in memory (useNavigationStore, no reload): Home → Docs → Assistant → Settings General/Libraries/About → Tasks. For Docs, make it the first visit after a page load
Screenshot the first render and record which strings appear (MutationObserver watcher)
expected: While a list is loading, each space shows a loading state (spinner/skeleton). Counts and empty-state copy stay hidden until data arrives, and actions that depend on the data wait.
actual: Home: the list shows a spinner, but the header says '0 local', the filters say All 0 / Recent 0, the status bar says 'designs 0' and the detail panel says 'Select a design' for the whole load. Assistant: 'No chats yet.', All 0 / Linked 0, header 'New chat' and the 'Start a PCB-focused conversation' empty state, all with no loading indicator. Tasks: 'No tasks yet.' for the whole load. Docs: the first visit after load paints 'No pages yet / Create your first page' before the skeleton (watcher: on at t=40 ms). Settings › Libraries: shows 'Loading…' (good), but 'Check for updates' is enabled while the status is unknown. When data lands, Assistant also reflows (the tools badge pops in, the model pill width changes) and the Libraries table header shifts 0.5 px. Only Docs (skeleton) and Settings › Libraries have a real loading state.

network: watcher events light: Docs 40ms 'No pages yet'; Home 6ms 'designs 0','0 local','Select a design' until 2648ms; Assistant 36ms 'No chats yet' until ~2585ms; Tasks 6ms 'No tasks yet'

codeRefs.note: '{designs.length} local', counts and 'designs {visible.length}' rendered regardless of loading
'No chats yet.' shown whenever filteredChats is empty — there is no chats-loading flag
EmptyState rendered while the selected chat's messages are still loading
no loading state
initial isLoading=false, so PageTree renders the empty state before the fetch effect runs

suggestedFix: Add a loading flag per list (Home designsLoaded, Assistant chatsLoaded/messagesLoaded, Tasks loaded). While it is false, hide counts ('—' or skeleton), status-bar numbers and empty-state copy, and render the kit skeleton. Initialise the Docs tree store with isLoading=true (or status 'idle' treated as loading). Disable 'Check for updates' until the core status is known.

title: List load failures have no in-place retry (Home, Assistant chats, Settings › Libraries) and fall back to 'No designs yet' / 'No chats yet.' empty states — recovery needs navigation
repro: In-page fetch shim returns 500 application/problem+json for GET /api/modules/designer/designs, /knowledge/workspaces/default/tree, /assistant/chats, /library/sources, /library/core-library/status
Navigate (in memory) to Home, Docs, Assistant, Settings › Libraries and screenshot each
Remove the shim (backend healthy again) and look for any in-UI way to retry without leaving the screen (dismiss, filter click, wait)
expected: Each list shows an error with a Retry action next to the failed list, never the 'nothing here, create one' empty state. Errors use human copy, not raw codes.
actual: Home: raw 'Failed to load designs: HTTP 500' strip above 'No designs yet / Create your first design' (no Retry). Clicking filters does not refetch; you have to leave Home and come back. Assistant: the sidebar says 'No chats yet.' (All 0) and a generic 'Internal error' banner sits in the thread area, unrelated to the list. Dismissing it leaves an empty list, nothing refetches, and the user is invited to start a new chat. It recovers only after leaving and re-entering Assistant. Settings › Libraries: 'Internal error' banner plus the core card and sources table stuck on 'Loading…'. It recovers only by switching tabs (General → Libraries). Docs is the only list with a working Retry, which fixed it in one click (after shim removal: 1 GET, 8 rows), but it shows the raw code 'HTTP_500' in raw red.

network: After shim removal: Home/Assistant made 0 requests until navigation; Settings refetched only on tab switch; Docs Retry → GET /knowledge/workspaces/default/tree 200

codeRefs.note: raw 'HTTP ${status}' message; error strip has no retry; emptyState still rendered
refreshConfig/refreshChats failure → generic setError in thread; no retry, chats stays []
sources===null stays 'Loading…' on error
only list with Retry (raw red + raw code)

suggestedFix: Adopt one kit ErrorState (message + Retry) for list loads and make every list use it: HomeScreen (fetchDesigns), Assistant (refreshChats and refreshConfig separately, shown in the sidebar where the list is), LibrariesPanel (loadSources/loadStatus), Tasks. Suppress the empty state while in error. Map status codes to human copy ('Couldn't load designs. The local service did not respond.') instead of 'HTTP 500'/'HTTP_500'. Related: Q1-003 (Home), Q2-014 (Settings), Q9-012 (Docs copy).

title: Wide markdown tables and unbroken URLs overflow the message column — the whole chat thread scrolls horizontally
repro: In-page mock: a chat whose assistant message (10k chars) contains a 30-column markdown table, a wide ```ts code block and a 300-char URL
Open the chat in the Assistant space and scroll to the message
Scroll the thread horizontally (trackpad / shift+wheel)
expected: Tables sit in their own horizontal scroller (like the code block does) and long tokens/URLs wrap. The thread itself never scrolls sideways.
actual: The table renders 2885 px wide and runs off the right edge. The URL runs to the viewport edge. The thread container becomes horizontally scrollable (scrollWidth 2949 vs clientWidth 1040), so panning sideways shifts every other message and leaves the prose cut off on the left. The code block is fine: it has its own overflow-x.

codeRefs.note: PROSE_CLASSES (space view) has no break-words / overflow-wrap:anywhere and no table overflow wrapper (prose-table:w-full only)
COMPACT_PROSE_CLASSES (dock) has break-words but also no table wrapper

suggestedFix: In the markdown renderer, wrap <table> in <div class='max-w-full overflow-x-auto'> (custom `table` component). Add `break-words [overflow-wrap:anywhere]` to PROSE_CLASSES. Set min-w-0 on the message column so flex children can shrink.

title: Docs page tree is unreadable past ~5 levels: titles collapse to 1–3 characters in the fixed 260px sidebar, with no tooltip or resize
repro: In-page mock: the page tree returns 300 pages, a chain nested 8 deep, titles up to 150 chars
Open Docs and expand the chain 000 › 020 › 021 › … › 026
expected: Deep pages stay identifiable: tighter indent or indentation capped, the sidebar is resizable, action buttons take no space until hover, and a full-title tooltip is available.
actual: Measured title widths per depth: 139, 123, 107, 91, 75, 59, 43, 27, 11 px. Depth 7–8 rows show '02…', '0.', '03…', '08…'. Each row still reserves 48 px for the invisible (opacity-0) Add-subpage/Delete buttons. Indent is 16 px per level. The sidebar is fixed at 260 px and not resizable. Rows have no title attribute. Rows are 36 px tall (shell rows are 22 px).

codeRefs.note: paddingLeft = level*16+4, uncapped
action group uses opacity-0 (keeps width) instead of hidden/absolute
truncate title with no title= tooltip
fixed w-[260px] sidebar

suggestedFix: Cap the indent (e.g. 12 px/level up to depth 4, then 6 px) or draw guide lines. Render the row actions absolutely positioned on hover/focus so they take no width at rest. Add title={node.title}. Make the Docs sidebar resizable like the Designer left panel (240–520). Adopt the kit 22–24 px tree row.

title: Deep-page breadcrumbs truncate away the parent and push the editor meta line into 3-line columns ('edited / 1h / ago', '3 / words'), even at 1440px
repro: In-page mock: 300-page tree, 8-deep chain with long titles
Docs search '027' → click the result (a page 8 levels deep)
expected: The breadcrumb shows the nearest ancestors (collapse the middle as '… /'), each crumb is clickable, and the 'edited … · N words' meta keeps a single line.
actual: The breadcrumb is one plain string truncated at the end, so it shows the root title and cuts off the immediate parent. The meta items get squeezed: 'edited 1h ago' wraps onto 3 lines and '3 words' onto 2, at 1440 as well as 1100. The crumbs are not links. Search results do the same: the breadcrumb line under each result truncates from the end, so for deep pages only the root title is visible and results can't be told apart.

codeRefs.note: breadcrumb.join(' / ') in a truncate span; siblings lack shrink-0/whitespace-nowrap
search result breadcrumb joined + end-truncated

suggestedFix: Render crumbs as buttons (onSelectPage). Collapse to 'Root / … / Parent' when there are more than 3 levels, with max-width per crumb and a title tooltip. Give the 'edited'/'words' spans shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap. In search results show 'Root / … / Parent', or direction:rtl truncation. Extends Q9-020 (meta wrap at 1100).

title: Docs fetches the page tree twice on every visit (two usePageTree instances race)
repro: Wrap window.fetch to log requests
Navigate Home → Docs (in memory)
Inspect the request log
actual: Two identical GETs fire in the same millisecond on every Docs mount (log: '30958 GET …/tree' ×2, '185698 GET …/tree' ×2). The Retry button fetches once.

codeRefs.note: usePageTree(designId) for the breadcrumb
second usePageTree(designId)
per-instance hasFetchedRef + render-time isLoading guard lets both instances fetch in the same commit

suggestedFix: Fetch once: move the fetch-on-scope logic into the tree store (e.g. ensureLoaded(scope) guarded by a store-level inflight promise), or have Space read the tree via useTreeStore(s => s.tree) instead of a second usePageTree.

title: Home renders every design row/card with its SVG thumbnail at once: a 0.36–0.54 s main-thread block at 300 designs (no virtualization)
repro: In-page mock: GET /api/modules/designer/designs returns 300 designs cloned from the real shape (real schematicPreview payloads, mixed names, every DRC state)
Navigate to Home (list), then toggle Grid
Record PerformanceObserver longtask entries; run a rAF scroll probe
expected: First paint of a 300-item list stays under ~100 ms (virtualized rows / lazy thumbnails). Scrolling stays at 60 fps.
actual: Long tasks: 465 ms (list, dark), 535 ms (list, light), 363 ms (List → Grid toggle). All 280 row DOM nodes and 300 SVG previews mount at once. Scrolling itself is smooth: list p95 16.8 ms per frame, grid avg 18.1 ms / p95 17.5 ms, no long tasks while scrolling. The only stalls >50 ms coincided with CLI screenshot/eval calls. The cost grows linearly with design count.

codeRefs.note: visible.map renders all rows
buildSchematicPreviewGeometry + full SVG per row, eagerly

suggestedFix: Virtualize the list/grid (fixed 64px rows make @tanstack/react-virtual trivial), or at least lazy-render thumbnails with IntersectionObserver / content-visibility:auto on rows.

title: Assistant header gives the chat title the least room: at 1100px only ~12 chars show while the linked-design chip, tools badge and model pill keep full width
repro: In-page mock: chat with a 120-char title linked to a design with a long name
Resize to 1100x720 and open the chat
expected: The title keeps priority: chips shrink or collapse to icons first, and the full title is available as a tooltip.
actual: The header reads 'F1D long thre…' (~85 px) while the linked-design chip keeps 140 px, the '15 tools' badge ~70 px and the model pill ~230 px. The title button's title attribute is 'Rename chat', not the chat name, so the full title can't be seen.

codeRefs.note: title button (title='Rename chat') + shrink-0 linked chip/tools badge/pill

suggestedFix: Make the linked-design chip and tools badge shrinkable (min-w-0, collapse to icon under ~1200px). Put the chat title in the title/tooltip. Give the title flex-basis priority.
